rust_summary: A player is about to nock a bow (`native_arrow_nock`).
doc_summary: A player is about to nock a bow: `native_arrow_nock(player, name, bow, hand, has_ammo, cancel)` is asked where `BowItem.use` would start using the item. `has_ammo` is whether `getProjectile` found ammunition (creative always has). Set `cancel` to make the use fail, as `InteractionResult.FAIL`. Crossbows and tridents do not ask. Bundles need "hooks": @API:arrow_nock@.
